children: Abu Dhabi’s XRG, the investment arm of state oil giant ADNOC, is in preliminary talks to acquire a minority stake in the LNG Canada project, according to a Bloomberg report.
The firm is negotiating to buy a portion of the stake owned by PetroChina, which holds a 15% ownership in the venture, the news agency reported, quoting sources familiar with the matter.
LNG Canada is a massive liquefied natural gas (LNG) export facility in British Columbia.
The move is part of Abu Dhabi’s push to become a major global player in natural gas and clean-burning fuels.
According to earlier reports, the state-owned PetroChina is looking to lower or divest part of its stake in the project, which is led by Shell with a 40% equity stake.
(Writing by Cleofe Maceda; editing by Seban Scaria) seban.scaria@lseg.com

title: UAE oil giant ADNOC’s investment arm XRG in talks to buy stake in LNG Canada – report
